sentences.chinese: 杂草这一次带了三件小雕刻去市场。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zhè yí cì dài le sān jiàn xiǎo diāo kè qù shì chǎng 。
sentences.english: This time, Weed brings three small carvings to the market.

sentences.chinese: 他比上次准备得更早。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǐ shàng cì zhǔn bèi dé gèng zǎo 。
sentences.english: He prepares earlier than last time.

sentences.chinese: 位置也选得更好。
sentences.pinyin: wèi zhì yě xuǎn dé gèng hǎo 。
sentences.english: He also chooses a better spot.

sentences.chinese: 他把东西摆得很整齐。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ dōng xī bǎi dé hěn zhěng qí 。
sentences.english: He arranges the pieces very neatly.

sentences.chinese: 然后站在旁边等。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu zhàn zài páng biān děng 。
sentences.english: Then he stands beside them and waits.

sentences.chinese: 一开始，他心里还有一点希望。
sentences.pinyin: yì kāi shǐ ， tā xīn lǐ hái yǒu yì diǎn xī wàng 。
sentences.english: At first, he still has a little hope in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 可是看的人虽然有，买的人却没有。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì kàn de rén suī rán yǒu ， mǎi de rén què méi yǒu 。
sentences.english: But although some people look, no one buys.

sentences.chinese: 有人只看一眼就走。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén zhī kàn yì yǎn jiù zǒu 。
sentences.english: Some people take one glance and leave.

sentences.chinese: 还有人问了价格以后，就像听见了什么笑话。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu rén wèn le jià gé yǐ hòu ， jiù xiàng tīng jiàn le shén me xiào huà 。
sentences.english: Others ask the price and then react as if they heard a joke.

sentences.chinese: 杂草的脸没有变。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo de liǎn méi yǒu biàn 。
sentences.english: Weed's face does not change.

sentences.chinese: 可是心里越来越沉。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì xīn lǐ yuè lái yuè chén 。
sentences.english: But inside, he feels heavier and heavier.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他开始想，也许只是价格太高。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， tā kāi shǐ xiǎng ， yě xǔ zhǐ shì jià gé tài gāo 。
sentences.english: Later, he begins to think that maybe the price is simply too high.

sentences.chinese: 所以他把价格降了一点。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā bǎ jià gé jiàng le yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: So he lowers the price a little.

sentences.chinese: 过了一会儿，还是没有人买。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí huì er ， hái shì méi yǒu rén mǎi 。
sentences.english: After a while, still no one buys.

sentences.chinese: 他又降了一点。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu jiàng le yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: He lowers it again.

sentences.chinese: 那三件东西还是一直摆着。
sentences.pinyin: nà sān jiàn dōng xī hái shì yì zhí bǎi zhe 。
sentences.english: Those three pieces still remain sitting there on display.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，杂草心里冒出一个很难听的想法。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hòu ， zá cǎo xīn lǐ mào chū yí gè hěn nán tīng de xiǎng fǎ 。
sentences.english: At this point, a harsh thought rises in Weed's mind.

sentences.chinese: 也许不是价格的问题。
sentences.pinyin: yě xǔ bú shì jià gé de wèn tí 。
sentences.english: Maybe it is not a price problem.

sentences.chinese: 也许是这些东西根本不值得卖。
sentences.pinyin: yě xǔ shì zhè xiē dōng xī gēn běn bù zhí dé mài 。
sentences.english: Maybe these pieces simply are not worth selling at all.

sentences.chinese: 他差一点就想把它们收起来。
sentences.pinyin: tā chà yì diǎn jiù xiǎng bǎ tā men shōu qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: He almost wants to pack them up.

sentences.chinese: 可是一个老人走过来，拿起其中一件，看了很久。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì yí gè lǎo rén zǒu guò lái ， ná qǐ qí zhōng yí jiàn ， kàn le hěn jiǔ 。
sentences.english: But an old man walks over, picks one up, and looks at it for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 老人最后没有买。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén zuì hòu méi yǒu mǎi 。
sentences.english: In the end, the old man does not buy it.

sentences.chinese: 老人只问：“这是你自己做的吗？”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén zhī wèn ： “ zhè shì nǐ zì jǐ zuò de ma ？ ”
sentences.english: The old man only asks, 'Did you make this yourself?'

sentences.chinese: 杂草点头。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo diǎn tóu 。
sentences.english: Weed nods.

sentences.chinese: 老人又问：“你为什么做这个样子？”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén yòu wèn ： “ nǐ wèi shén me zuò zhè ge yàng zi ？ ”
sentences.english: The old man asks again, 'Why did you make it look like this?'

sentences.chinese: 杂草一下子说不出来。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yí xià zǐ shuō bù chū lái 。
sentences.english: Weed suddenly cannot answer.

sentences.chinese: 因为他刚才只想着卖掉它。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā gāng cái zhī xiǎng zhe mài diào tā 。
sentences.english: Because a moment ago, he was only thinking about selling it.

sentences.chinese: 他没有想过怎么解释它。
sentences.pinyin: tā méi yǒu xiǎng guò zěn me jiě shì tā 。
sentences.english: He had not thought about how to explain it.

sentences.chinese: 老人把东西放回去，说：“价格不是最先要想的事。”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén bǎ dōng xī fàng huí qù ， shuō ： “ jià gé bú shì zuì xiān yào xiǎng de shì 。 ”
sentences.english: The old man puts the piece back and says, 'Price is not the first thing to think about.'

sentences.chinese: “你要先知道，自己做的是什么。”
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ yào xiān zhī dào ， zì jǐ zuò de shì shén me 。 ”
sentences.english: 'First you need to know what it is that you made.'

sentences.chinese: 老人走了以后，杂草没有再降价格。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén zǒu le yǐ hòu ， zá cǎo méi yǒu zài jiàng jià gé 。
sentences.english: After the old man leaves, Weed does not lower the price again.

sentences.chinese: 他只是站在那里，看着自己的三件作品。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì zhàn zài nà lǐ ， kàn zhe zì jǐ de sān jiàn zuò pǐn 。
sentences.english: He only stands there, looking at his three pieces.

sentences.chinese: 那天他还是没有卖掉。
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān tā hái shì méi yǒu mài diào 。
sentences.english: That day, he still does not sell them.

sentences.chinese: 可是回去的时候，他第一次不是只想“怎么卖”。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì huí qù de shí hòu ， tā dì yī cì bú shì zhī xiǎng “ zěn me mài ” 。
sentences.english: But on the way back, for the first time he is not only thinking, 'How do I sell this?'

sentences.chinese: 他开始想：“我到底做了什么？”
sentences.pinyin: tā kāi shǐ xiǎng ： “ wǒ dào dǐ zuò le shén me ？ ”
sentences.english: He starts thinking, 'What did I actually make?'

sentences.chinese: 杂草那天想做一个笑着的小人。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo nà tiān xiǎng zuò yí gè xiào zhe de xiǎo rén 。
sentences.english: That day, Weed wants to make a little figure with a smile.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得笑脸看起来很简单。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de xiào liǎn kàn qǐ lái hěn jiǎn dān 。
sentences.english: He thinks a smiling face looks simple.

sentences.chinese: 嘴角往上一点，不就可以了吗？
sentences.pinyin: zuǐ jiǎo wǎng shàng yì diǎn ， bú jiù kě yǐ le ma ？
sentences.english: You just lift the corners of the mouth a little, right?

sentences.chinese: 可是第一件做出来的时候，他自己先皱了眉。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì dì yī jiàn zuò chū lái de shí hòu ， tā zì jǐ xiān zhòu le méi 。
sentences.english: But when the first piece is done, he frowns first himself.

sentences.chinese: 那个小人像是在忍痛。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge xiǎo rén xiàng shì zài rěn tòng 。
sentences.english: The little figure looks like it is enduring pain.

sentences.chinese: 一点也不像在笑。
sentences.pinyin: yì diǎn yě bú xiàng zài xiào 。
sentences.english: It does not look like it is smiling at all.

sentences.chinese: 杂草不高兴，又做第二次。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo bù gāo xìng ， yòu zuò dì èr cì 。
sentences.english: Weed is unhappy and makes it a second time.

sentences.chinese: 第二次的嘴更开。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr cì de zuǐ gèng kāi 。
sentences.english: The mouth is more open in the second one.

sentences.chinese: 可是眼睛却很僵。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì yǎn jīng què hěn jiāng 。
sentences.english: But the eyes are very stiff.

sentences.chinese: 看起来还是不对。
sentences.pinyin: kàn qǐ lái hái shì bú duì 。
sentences.english: It still does not look right.

sentences.chinese: 杂草本来以为，只要形状像，东西就会像。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo běn lái yǐ wéi ， zhǐ yào xíng zhuàng xiàng ， dōng xī jiù huì xiàng 。
sentences.english: Weed had thought that as long as the shape looked right, the thing itself would look right.

sentences.chinese: 现在他才发现，笑不是只有嘴。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā cái fā xiàn ， xiào bú shì zhǐ yǒu zuǐ 。
sentences.english: Now he realizes that a smile is not only the mouth.

sentences.chinese: 眼睛也要笑。
sentences.pinyin: yǎn jīng yě yào xiào 。
sentences.english: The eyes also need to smile.

sentences.chinese: 脸也要放松。
sentences.pinyin: liǎn yě yào fàng sōng 。
sentences.english: The face also has to relax.

sentences.chinese: 他坐在那里，看着前面的失败品。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò zài nà lǐ ， kàn zhe qián miàn de shī bài pǐn 。
sentences.english: He sits there looking at the failed pieces in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 过了一会儿，他拿来一面小镜子。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí huì er ， tā ná lái yí miàn xiǎo jìng zi 。
sentences.english: After a while, he brings over a small mirror.

sentences.chinese: 他先看自己的脸。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān kàn zì jǐ de liǎn 。
sentences.english: He first looks at his own face.

sentences.chinese: 然后试着笑一下。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu shì zhe xiào yí xià 。
sentences.english: Then he tries smiling a little.

sentences.chinese: 第一次笑得很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: dì yī cì xiào dé hěn qí guài 。
sentences.english: The first smile looks strange.

sentences.chinese: 第二次也不太自然。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr cì yě bú tài zì rán 。
sentences.english: The second one is also not very natural.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他想到妹妹高兴的时候的样子。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， tā xiǎng dào mèi mei gāo xìng de shí hòu de yàng zi 。
sentences.english: Later, he thinks of how his younger sister looks when she is happy.

sentences.chinese: 又想到奶奶轻轻笑的时候。
sentences.pinyin: yòu xiǎng dào nǎi nai qīng qīng xiào de shí hòu 。
sentences.english: Then he thinks of his grandma smiling softly.

sentences.chinese: 他忽然明白，自己不能只靠记住线。
sentences.pinyin: tā hū rán míng bái ， zì jǐ bù néng zhī kào jì zhù xiàn 。
sentences.english: He suddenly understands that he cannot rely only on remembering lines.

sentences.chinese: 自己还要观察人。
sentences.pinyin: zì jǐ hái yào guān chá rén 。
sentences.english: He also has to observe people.

sentences.chinese: 第三次下刀的时候，他慢了很多。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān cì xià dāo de shí hòu ， tā màn le hěn duō 。
sentences.english: When he cuts for the third time, he is much slower.

sentences.chinese: 他先做眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān zuò yǎn jīng 。
sentences.english: He shapes the eyes first.

sentences.chinese: 后来才做嘴。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái cái zuò zuǐ 。
sentences.english: Only later does he shape the mouth.

sentences.chinese: 做完以后，那张脸还是很简单。
sentences.pinyin: zuò wán yǐ hòu ， nà zhāng liǎn hái shì hěn jiǎn dān 。
sentences.english: After finishing, the face is still very simple.

sentences.chinese: 可是这一次，看起来终于像真的在笑。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí cì ， kàn qǐ lái zhōng yú xiàng zhēn de zài xiào 。
sentences.english: But this time, it finally looks like it is really smiling.

sentences.chinese: 杂草看了很久，自己也轻轻笑了一下。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn le hěn jiǔ ， zì jǐ yě qīng qīng xiào le yí xià 。
sentences.english: Weed looks at it for a long time and also gives a small smile himself.

sentences.chinese: 他终于明白，有些东西不能只靠手学。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhōng yú míng bái ， yǒu xiē dōng xī bù néng zhī kào shǒu xué 。
sentences.english: He finally understands that some things cannot be learned only with the hands.

sentences.chinese: 有些东西，要先学会看。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē dōng xī ， yào xiān xué huì kàn 。
sentences.english: Some things must first be learned by watching.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，杂草正在市场边上整理自己的东西。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān ， zá cǎo zhèng zài shì chǎng biān shàng zhěng lǐ zì jǐ de dōng xī 。
sentences.english: One day, Weed is organizing his things at the side of the market.

sentences.chinese: 一个人停在他面前。
sentences.pinyin: yí gè rén tíng zài tā miàn qián 。
sentences.english: A person stops in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 杂草抬头一看，觉得这个人有一点眼熟。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tái tóu yí kàn ， jué de zhè ge rén yǒu yì diǎn yǎn shú 。
sentences.english: Weed looks up and thinks the person seems a little familiar.

sentences.chinese: 后来他才想起来。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái tā cái xiǎng qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: Then he finally remembers.

sentences.chinese: 这个人以前买过他一个小雕刻。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rén yǐ qián mǎi guò tā yí gè xiǎo diāo kè 。
sentences.english: This person bought one of his small carvings before.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，杂草只觉得自己运气不错。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hòu ， zá cǎo zhī jué de zì jǐ yùn qì bú cuò 。
sentences.english: At that time, Weed only thought he had gotten lucky.

sentences.chinese: 买完以后，客人就走了。
sentences.pinyin: mǎi wán yǐ hòu ， kè rén jiù zǒu le 。
sentences.english: After buying it, the customer left.

sentences.chinese: 所以杂草没有再多想。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zá cǎo méi yǒu zài duō xiǎng 。
sentences.english: So Weed did not think more about it.

sentences.chinese: 可是现在，这个人又回头了。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì xiàn zài ， zhè ge rén yòu huí tóu le 。
sentences.english: But now, this person has come back.

sentences.chinese: 客人先看了看摊上的东西。
sentences.pinyin: kè rén xiān kàn le kàn tān shàng de dōng xī 。
sentences.english: The customer first looks over the pieces on display.

sentences.chinese: 然后说：“你最近做得比以前更好了。”
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu shuō ： “ nǐ zuì jìn zuò dé bǐ yǐ qián gèng hǎo le 。 ”
sentences.english: Then says, 'What you've made lately is better than before.'

sentences.chinese: 杂草听见这句话，心里先是一愣。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng jiàn zhè jù huà ， xīn lǐ xiān shì yí lèng 。
sentences.english: When Weed hears that sentence, he is startled first.

sentences.chinese: 因为他没有想到，对方会记得。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā méi yǒu xiǎng dào ， duì fāng huì jì de 。
sentences.english: Because he did not expect the other person to remember.

sentences.chinese: 在他心里，卖掉就是卖掉了。
sentences.pinyin: zài tā xīn lǐ ， mài diào jiù shì mài diào le 。
sentences.english: In his mind, once something is sold, it is simply sold.

sentences.chinese: 东西离手，事情也就结束。
sentences.pinyin: dōng xī lí shǒu ， shì qíng yě jiù jié shù 。
sentences.english: Once the item leaves his hand, the matter is over.

sentences.chinese: 可是这个客人不是这样。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè ge kè rén bú shì zhè yàng 。
sentences.english: But this customer is not like that.

sentences.chinese: 客人又说：“上次那个我朋友很喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: kè rén yòu shuō ： “ shàng cì nà ge wǒ péng yǒu hěn xǐ huan 。 ”
sentences.english: The customer adds, 'My friend liked the one from last time very much.'

sentences.chinese: “所以我想再看看。”
sentences.pinyin: “ suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng zài kàn kàn 。 ”
sentences.english: 'So I wanted to come look again.'

sentences.chinese: 杂草这一次没有马上报价格。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zhè yí cì méi yǒu mǎ shàng bào jià gé 。
sentences.english: This time, Weed does not quote a price right away.

sentences.chinese: 他先把两件比较像的作品拿出来。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān bǎ liǎng jiàn bǐ jiào xiàng de zuò pǐn ná chū lái 。
sentences.english: He first brings out two pieces that are somewhat similar.

sentences.chinese: 又说了它们不一样的地方。
sentences.pinyin: yòu shuō le tā men bù yí yàng de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: Then he explains how they are different.

sentences.chinese: 客人听得很认真。
sentences.pinyin: kè rén tīng dé hěn rèn zhēn 。
sentences.english: The customer listens very carefully.

sentences.chinese: 最后选了一件新的。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu xuǎn le yí jiàn xīn de 。
sentences.english: In the end, the customer chooses a new one.

sentences.chinese: 付钱的时候，客人笑着说：“以后我还会来。”
sentences.pinyin: fù qián de shí hòu ， kè rén xiào zhe shuō ： “ yǐ hòu wǒ hái huì lái 。 ”
sentences.english: While paying, the customer smiles and says, 'I'll come again later.'

sentences.chinese: 客人走了以后，杂草还站在那里。
sentences.pinyin: kè rén zǒu le yǐ hòu ， zá cǎo hái zhàn zài nà lǐ 。
sentences.english: After the customer leaves, Weed is still standing there.

sentences.chinese: 市场照样很吵。
sentences.pinyin: shì chǎng zhào yàng hěn chǎo 。
sentences.english: The market is still noisy as usual.

sentences.chinese: 可是他心里有一种新的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā xīn lǐ yǒu yì zhǒng xīn de gǎn jué 。
sentences.english: But there is a new feeling in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 原来有人不是只买一次。

sentences.chinese: 也可以让人舍不得碰。
sentences.pinyin: yě kě yǐ ràng rén shè bù dé pèng 。
sentences.english: It can also make someone reluctant to touch it.

sentences.chinese: 那件小狗雕刻还是放在那里。
sentences.pinyin: nà jiàn xiǎo gǒu diāo kè hái shì fàng zài nà lǐ 。
sentences.english: That little dog carving is still sitting there.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草再看它的时候，已经觉得它比刚才更珍贵了一点。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo zài kàn tā de shí hòu ， yǐ jīng jué de tā bǐ gāng cái gèng zhēn guì le yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: But when Weed looks at it again, he already feels it is a little more precious than before.

sentences.chinese: 市场里有一种客人，杂草一直不太喜欢。
sentences.pinyin: shì chǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhǒng kè rén ， zá cǎo yì zhí bú tài xǐ huan 。
sentences.english: There is one kind of customer in the market that Weed has never liked much.

sentences.chinese: 那种人来得快，走得也快。
sentences.pinyin: nà zhǒng rén lái de kuài ， zǒu dé yě kuài 。
sentences.english: That kind of person comes quickly and leaves quickly.

sentences.chinese: 只看一眼，就先开口。
sentences.pinyin: zhī kàn yì yǎn ， jiù xiān kāi kǒu 。
sentences.english: After one glance, they speak first.

sentences.chinese: 那天，他就遇到了这样一个人。
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān ， tā jiù yù dào le zhè yàng yí gè rén 。
sentences.english: That day, he meets exactly such a person.

sentences.chinese: 那个人走过来，随手拿起一个小雕刻。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén zǒu guò lái ， suí shǒu ná qǐ yí gè xiǎo diāo kè 。
sentences.english: The person walks over and casually picks up a small carving.

sentences.chinese: 只看了一眼，就说：“这个不行。”
sentences.pinyin: zhī kàn le yì yǎn ， jiù shuō ： “ zhè ge bù xíng 。 ”
sentences.english: After one glance, the person says, 'This one won't do.'

sentences.chinese: 又看了第二件，也说：“这个也不行。”
sentences.pinyin: yòu kàn le dì èr jiàn ， yě shuō ： “ zhè ge yě bù xíng 。 ”
sentences.english: Then looks at a second one and says, 'This one won't do either.'

sentences.chinese: 杂草听见这些话，心里马上被刺了一下。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng jiàn zhè xiē huà ， xīn lǐ mǎ shàng bèi cì le yí xià 。
sentences.english: Hearing those words, Weed feels an immediate sting inside.

sentences.chinese: 因为那个人根本没有认真看。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi nà ge rén gēn běn méi yǒu rèn zhēn kàn 。
sentences.english: Because that person did not look seriously at all.

sentences.chinese: 可是评价却说得很快。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì píng jià què shuō dé hěn kuài 。
sentences.english: Yet the judgment comes very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 杂草差一点就想回话。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo chà yì diǎn jiù xiǎng huí huà 。
sentences.english: Weed almost wants to answer back.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至已经想到好几句难听的话。
sentences.pinyin: tā shèn zhì yǐ jīng xiǎng dào hǎo jǐ jù nán tīng de huà 。
sentences.english: He has even already thought of several harsh lines.

sentences.chinese: 可是话到嘴边，他又停住了。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì huà dào zuǐ biān ， tā yòu tíng zhù le 。
sentences.english: But when the words reach his lips, he stops again.

sentences.chinese: 他忽然想到，自己如果现在回过去，会有什么结果。
sentences.pinyin: tā hū rán xiǎng dào ， zì jǐ rú guǒ xiàn zài huí guò qù ， huì yǒu shén me jié guǒ 。
sentences.english: He suddenly thinks about what will happen if he fires back now.

sentences.chinese: 今天一整天都会坏掉。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān yì zhěng tiān dōu huì huài diào 。
sentences.english: The whole day will be ruined.

sentences.chinese: 而那个人说完就会走。
sentences.pinyin: ér nà ge rén shuō wán jiù huì zǒu 。
sentences.english: And that person will leave right after speaking.

sentences.chinese: 最后留下来生气的人，还是自己。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu liú xià lái shēng qì de rén ， hái shì zì jǐ 。
sentences.english: The one left behind feeling angry will still be himself.

sentences.chinese: 所以杂草没有争。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zá cǎo méi yǒu zhēng 。
sentences.english: So Weed does not argue.

sentences.chinese: 那个人果然很快就走了。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén guǒ rán hěn kuài jiù zǒu le 。
sentences.english: Sure enough, the person leaves very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 杂草一个人站在原地，心里还是很乱。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yí gè rén zhàn zài yuán dì ， xīn lǐ hái shì hěn luàn 。
sentences.english: Weed stands there alone, and his mind is still very unsettled.

sentences.chinese: 他低头看着自己的作品。
sentences.pinyin: tā dī tóu kàn zhe zì jǐ de zuò pǐn 。
sentences.english: He lowers his head and looks at his own work.

sentences.chinese: 然后慢慢问自己一个问题。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu màn màn wèn zì jǐ yí gè wèn tí 。
sentences.english: Then he slowly asks himself one question.

sentences.chinese: 那个人真的看懂了吗？
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén zhēn de kàn dǒng le ma ？
sentences.english: Did that person really understand what he saw?

sentences.chinese: 答案当然是没有。
sentences.pinyin: dá àn dāng rán shì méi yǒu 。
sentences.english: The answer is of course no.

sentences.chinese: 想到这里，杂草的气慢慢下去了一点。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào zhè lǐ ， zá cǎo de qì màn màn xià qù le yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: Thinking this, Weed's anger slowly goes down a little.

sentences.chinese: 因为他终于知道，不是每一句话都值得放进心里。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā zhōng yú zhī dào ， bú shì měi yí jù huà dōu zhí dé fàng jìn xīn lǐ 。
sentences.english: Because he finally knows that not every sentence is worth placing in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他把那件作品拿近一点，又认真看了一次。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， tā bǎ nà jiàn zuò pǐn ná jìn yì diǎn ， yòu rèn zhēn kàn le yí cì 。
sentences.english: Later, he brings the piece closer and looks at it seriously once more.

sentences.chinese: 他发现上面当然还有问题。
sentences.pinyin: tā fā xiàn shàng miàn dāng rán hái yǒu wèn tí 。
sentences.english: He finds that of course there are still problems in it.

sentences.chinese: 可是那些问题，不是刚才那个人随手说出来的那些。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì nà xiē wèn tí ， bú shì gāng cái nà ge rén suí shǒu shuō chū lái de nà xiē 。
sentences.english: But those are not the same problems that person casually spoke about.

sentences.chinese: 杂草这一次没有再想那个人。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zhè yí cì méi yǒu zài xiǎng nà ge rén 。
sentences.english: This time, Weed stops thinking about that person.

sentences.chinese: 他只开始想下一件。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī kāi shǐ xiǎng xià yí jiàn 。
sentences.english: He only starts thinking about the next piece.

sentences.chinese: 他终于明白，想走得稳一点，就要把心留给真正专心看的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhōng yú míng bái ， xiǎng zǒu dé wěn yì diǎn ， jiù yào bǎ xīn liú gěi zhēn zhèng zhuān xīn kàn de rén 。
sentences.english: He finally understands that if he wants to walk more steadily, he has to keep his heart for the people who truly look with focus.

sentences.chinese: 杂草最近开始觉得，做东西最烦的时候，不一定是下刀。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zuì jìn kāi shǐ jué de ， zuò dōng xī zuì fán de shí hòu ， bù yí dìng shì xià dāo 。
sentences.english: Lately, Weed begins to feel that the most frustrating part of making things is not always the carving itself.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，最烦的是等。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hòu ， zuì fán de shì děng 。
sentences.english: Sometimes, the most frustrating part is waiting.

sentences.chinese: 有的木头不能马上用。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de mù tou bù néng mǎ shàng yòng 。
sentences.english: Some wood cannot be used right away.

sentences.chinese: 有的地方也不能马上改。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de dì fāng yě bù néng mǎ shàng gǎi 。
sentences.english: Some parts also cannot be fixed immediately.

sentences.chinese: 要先等一等。
sentences.pinyin: yào xiān děng yī děng 。
sentences.english: You have to wait a little first.

sentences.chinese: 杂草以前最不喜欢这个步骤。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yǐ qián zuì bù xǐ huan zhè ge bù zhòu 。
sentences.english: Weed used to dislike this step the most.

sentences.chinese: 因为在他心里，等就是什么都没做。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zài tā xīn lǐ ， děng jiù shì shén me dōu méi zuò 。
sentences.english: Because in his mind, waiting meant doing nothing.

sentences.chinese: 什么都没做，就让人着急。
sentences.pinyin: shén me dōu méi zuò ， jiù ràng rén zháo jí 。
sentences.english: Doing nothing makes a person anxious.

sentences.chinese: 那天，他又遇到了要等的情况。
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān ， tā yòu yù dào le yào děng de qíng kuàng 。
sentences.english: That day, he runs into another situation where he has to wait.

sentences.chinese: 一块木头还没有完全干。
sentences.pinyin: yí kuài mù tou hái méi yǒu wán quán gān 。
sentences.english: A piece of wood is not fully dry yet.

sentences.chinese: 如果现在下刀，后面一定会出问题。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ xiàn zài xià dāo ， hòu miàn yí dìng huì chū wèn tí 。
sentences.english: If he cuts it now, there will definitely be problems later.

sentences.chinese: 杂草当然知道这个。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo dāng rán zhī dào zhè ge 。
sentences.english: Of course Weed knows this.

sentences.chinese: 可是知道，不等于心里愿意。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhī dào ， bù děng yú xīn lǐ yuàn yì 。
sentences.english: But knowing is not the same as being willing inside.

sentences.chinese: 他坐在那里，看着那块木头，越看越急。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò zài nà lǐ ， kàn zhe nà kuài mù tou ， yuè kàn yuè jí 。
sentences.english: He sits there looking at the wood, and the more he looks, the more anxious he gets.

sentences.chinese: 他差一点就想先做下去再说。
sentences.pinyin: tā chà yì diǎn jiù xiǎng xiān zuò xià qù zài shuō 。
sentences.english: He almost wants to keep working on it first and deal with the rest later.

sentences.chinese: 可是这一次，他没有。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí cì ， tā méi yǒu 。
sentences.english: But this time, he does not.

sentences.chinese: 他忽然想到，也许等本来就是工作的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: tā hū rán xiǎng dào ， yě xǔ děng běn lái jiù shì gōng zuò de yí bù fen 。
sentences.english: He suddenly thinks that maybe waiting is simply part of the work.

sentences.chinese: 如果自己提前知道要等，为什么不先去做别的步骤？
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zì jǐ tí qián zhī dào yào děng ， wèi shén me bù xiān qù zuò bié de bù zhòu ？
sentences.english: If he knows in advance that he has to wait, why not do a different step first?

sentences.chinese: 想到这里，杂草站了起来。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào zhè lǐ ， zá cǎo zhàn le qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: Thinking this, Weed stands up.

sentences.chinese: 他把旁边还没整理好的工具先整理好。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ páng biān hái méi zhěng lǐ hǎo de gōng jù xiān zhěng lǐ hǎo 。
sentences.english: He first organizes the tools nearby that had not yet been put in order.

sentences.chinese: 又把下一块木头也先看了一遍。
sentences.pinyin: yòu bǎ xià yí kuài mù tou yě xiān kàn le yí biàn 。
sentences.english: Then he looks over the next piece of wood in advance too.

sentences.chinese: 后来还记下了几个想改的地方。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái hái jì xià le jǐ gè xiǎng gǎi de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: Later, he also writes down a few places he wants to adjust.

sentences.chinese: 等他再回来的时候，那块木头已经差不多好了。
sentences.pinyin: děng tā zài huí lái de shí hòu ， nà kuài mù tou yǐ jīng chà bù duō hǎo le 。
sentences.english: By the time he returns, the piece of wood is almost ready.

sentences.chinese: 杂草低头看着它，心里有一点奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo dī tóu kàn zhe tā ， xīn lǐ yǒu yì diǎn qí guài 。
sentences.english: Weed looks down at it and feels a little strange inside.

sentences.chinese: 因为刚才那段时间，他明明没有下刀。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi gāng cái nà duàn shí jiān ， tā míng míng méi yǒu xià dāo 。
sentences.english: Because during that stretch of time, he clearly did not carve at all.

sentences.chinese: 可是事情还是往前走了。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì shì qíng hái shì wǎng qián zǒu le 。
sentences.english: But things still moved forward.

sentences.chinese: 那一刻他才明白，等不是空白。
sentences.pinyin: nà yí kè tā cái míng bái ， děng bú shì kòng bái 。
sentences.english: At that moment he understands that waiting is not blank time.

sentences.chinese: 等也是一种做事的方法。
sentences.pinyin: děng yě shì yì zhǒng zuò shì de fāng fǎ 。
sentences.english: Waiting is also a way of working.

sentences.chinese: 从那以后，杂草还是不喜欢等。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu ， zá cǎo hái shì bù xǐ huan děng 。
sentences.english: After that, Weed still does not like waiting.

sentences.chinese: 可是他已经学会，怎么让等也变成前进。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā yǐ jīng xué huì ， zěn me ràng děng yě biàn chéng qián jìn 。
sentences.english: But he has learned how to make waiting become progress too.

sentences.chinese: 以前在市场里，很少有人问杂草叫什么。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián zài shì chǎng lǐ ， hěn shǎo yǒu rén wèn zá cǎo jiào shén me 。
sentences.english: Before, very few people in the market asked what Weed was called.

sentences.chinese: 大家只看东西。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā zhī kàn dōng xī 。
sentences.english: People only looked at the items.

sentences.chinese: 买不买，也只看东西。
sentences.pinyin: mǎi bu mǎi ， yě zhī kàn dōng xī 。
sentences.english: Whether to buy or not also depended only on the items.

sentences.chinese: 杂草以前也觉得这样最好。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yǐ qián yě jué de zhè yàng zuì hǎo 。
sentences.english: Weed used to think that this was best too.

sentences.chinese: 名字不重要。
sentences.pinyin: míng zì bú zhòng yào 。
sentences.english: The name was not important.

sentences.chinese: 只要能卖出去，就够了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào néng mài chū qù ， jiù gòu le 。
sentences.english: As long as things sold, that was enough.

sentences.chinese: 可是有一天，一个客人买完东西以后，没有马上走。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì yǒu yì tiān ， yí gè kè rén mǎi wán dōng xī yǐ hòu ， méi yǒu mǎ shàng zǒu 。
sentences.english: But one day, after buying something, a customer does not leave right away.

sentences.chinese: 客人把东西收好以后，抬头问他：“这个是谁做的？”
sentences.pinyin: kè rén bǎ dōng xī shōu hǎo yǐ hòu ， tái tóu wèn tā ： “ zhè ge shì shuí zuò de ？ ”
sentences.english: After putting the item away, the customer looks up and asks, 'Who made this?'

sentences.chinese: 杂草先说：“我。”
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo xiān shuō ： “ wǒ 。 ”
sentences.english: Weed first says, 'Me.'

sentences.chinese: 客人又问：“那你叫什么名字？”
sentences.pinyin: kè rén yòu wèn ： “ nà nǐ jiào shén me míng zì ？ ”
sentences.english: The customer asks again, 'Then what is your name?'

sentences.chinese: 这一句很简单。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí jù hěn jiǎn dān 。
sentences.english: That sentence is very simple.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草却停了一下。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo què tíng le yí xià 。
sentences.english: But Weed pauses for a moment.

sentences.chinese: 因为他从前很少想这件事。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā cóng qián hěn shǎo xiǎng zhè jiàn shì 。
sentences.english: Because before, he rarely thought about this.

sentences.chinese: 在他心里，名字像是多出来的东西。
sentences.pinyin: zài tā xīn lǐ ， míng zì xiàng shì duō chū lái de dōng xī 。
sentences.english: In his mind, a name feels like something extra.

sentences.chinese: 东西能不能站住，才是真的。
sentences.pinyin: dōng xī néng bu néng zhàn zhù ， cái shì zhēn de 。
sentences.english: Whether the item can stand on its own is what is real.

sentences.chinese: 可是现在，他忽然觉得，也许不只是这样。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì xiàn zài ， tā hū rán jué de ， yě xǔ bù zhǐ shì zhè yàng 。
sentences.english: But now, he suddenly feels maybe it is not only that.

sentences.chinese: 如果别人问名字，不只是因为好奇。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bié rén wèn míng zì ， bù zhǐ shì yīn wèi hào qí 。
sentences.english: If someone asks a name, it is not only because of curiosity.

sentences.chinese: 也许是因为对方想记住是谁做的。
sentences.pinyin: yě xǔ shì yīn wèi duì fāng xiǎng jì zhù shì shuí zuò de 。
sentences.english: Maybe it is also because the person wants to remember who made it.

sentences.chinese: 想到这里，杂草说出了自己的名字。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào zhè lǐ ， zá cǎo shuō chū le zì jǐ de míng zì 。
sentences.english: Thinking this, Weed says his name aloud.

sentences.chinese: 客人点了点头。
sentences.pinyin: kè rén diǎn le diǎn tóu 。
sentences.english: The customer nods.

sentences.chinese: 客人说：“如果我朋友喜欢，我会再来找你。”
sentences.pinyin: kè rén shuō ： “ rú guǒ wǒ péng yǒu xǐ huan ， wǒ huì zài lái zhǎo nǐ 。 ”
sentences.english: The customer says, 'If my friend likes it, I'll come find you again.'

sentences.chinese: 客人走了以后，杂草站了很久。
sentences.pinyin: kè rén zǒu le yǐ hòu ， zá cǎo zhàn le hěn jiǔ 。
sentences.english: After the customer leaves, Weed stands there for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 市场里的人还是很多。
sentences.pinyin: shì chǎng lǐ de rén hái shì hěn duō 。
sentences.english: There are still many people in the market.

sentences.chinese: 声音也还是一样乱。
sentences.pinyin: shēng yīn yě hái shì yí yàng luàn 。
sentences.english: The noise is still just as messy.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草心里却多了一件新的事。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo xīn lǐ què duō le yí jiàn xīn de shì 。
sentences.english: But inside Weed, there is one new thought.

sentences.chinese: 原来把名字留在东西后面，不只是为了出名。
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái bǎ míng zì liú zài dōng xī hòu miàn ， bù zhǐ shì wèi le chū míng 。
sentences.english: Leaving a name behind a piece is not only for becoming famous.

sentences.chinese: 也是在说：这个东西，我认。
sentences.pinyin: yě shì zài shuō ： zhè ge dōng xī ， wǒ rèn 。
sentences.english: It is also saying: I acknowledge this piece as mine.

sentences.chinese: 这个好也好，不好也好，我都负责。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge hǎo yě hǎo ， bù hǎo yě hǎo ， wǒ dōu fù zé 。
sentences.english: Whether it is good or not, I take responsibility for it.

sentences.chinese: 那一天以后，杂草第一次认真想。
sentences.pinyin: nà yì tiān yǐ hòu ， zá cǎo dì yī cì rèn zhēn xiǎng 。
sentences.english: After that day, Weed seriously considers something for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 自己的名字也许会慢慢传开。
sentences.pinyin: zì jǐ de míng zì yě xǔ huì màn màn chuán kāi 。
sentences.english: His name may slowly begin to spread.

sentences.chinese: 杂草最近做的东西，大部分都拿去卖。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zuì jìn zuò de dōng xī ， dà bù fen dōu ná qù mài 。
sentences.english: Most of the things Weed has made lately have been taken to sell.

sentences.chinese: 因为在他心里，东西如果不能马上变成钱，就很难安心。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zài tā xīn lǐ ， dōng xī rú guǒ bù néng mǎ shàng biàn chéng qián ， jiù hěn nán ān xīn 。
sentences.english: Because in his mind, if something cannot immediately turn into money, it is hard to feel at ease.

sentences.chinese: 这也是他一直以来最习惯的想法。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yě shì tā yì zhí yǐ lái zuì xí guàn de xiǎng fǎ 。
sentences.english: This is also the way of thinking he has been most used to all along.

sentences.chinese: 可是那一天，他忽然不想这样。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì nà yì tiān ， tā hū rán bù xiǎng zhè yàng 。
sentences.english: But that day, he suddenly does not want to do that.

sentences.chinese: 他想做一件不卖的作品。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng zuò yí jiàn bú mài de zuò pǐn 。
sentences.english: He wants to make one piece that he will not sell.

sentences.chinese: 连他自己也觉得这个想法有一点奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: lián tā zì jǐ yě jué de zhè ge xiǎng fǎ yǒu yì diǎn qí guài 。
sentences.english: Even he himself thinks this idea is a little strange.

sentences.chinese: 因为做了不卖，好像就没有目的。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zuò le bú mài ， hǎo xiàng jiù méi yǒu mù dì 。
sentences.english: Because if he makes something and does not sell it, it seems to have no purpose.

sentences.chinese: 没有目的，就像在浪费时间。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu mù dì ， jiù xiàng zài làng fèi shí jiān 。
sentences.english: And without a purpose, it feels like wasting time.

sentences.chinese: 可是这个念头一直没有走。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè ge niàn tou yì zhí méi yǒu zǒu 。
sentences.english: But this thought does not leave.

sentences.chinese: 最后，杂草还是坐下来做了。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu ， zá cǎo hái shì zuò xià lái zuò le 。
sentences.english: In the end, Weed still sits down and makes it.

sentences.chinese: 这一次，他没有去想谁会买。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì ， tā méi yǒu qù xiǎng shuí huì mǎi 。
sentences.english: This time, he does not think about who will buy it.

sentences.chinese: 也没有去想能卖多少钱。
sentences.pinyin: yě méi yǒu qù xiǎng néng mài duō shǎo qián 。
sentences.english: He also does not think about how much it can sell for.

sentences.chinese: 他只想试一个自己还不会的样子。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī xiǎng shì yí gè zì jǐ hái bú huì de yàng zi 。
sentences.english: He only wants to try a form he still does not know how to make.

sentences.chinese: 开始的时候，他还是有一点不习惯。
sentences.pinyin: kāi shǐ de shí hòu ， tā hái shì yǒu yì diǎn bù xí guàn 。
sentences.english: At the beginning, he still feels a little unaccustomed.

sentences.chinese: 每做一会儿，脑子里就会冒出一个声音。
sentences.pinyin: měi zuò yí huì er ， nǎo zǐ lǐ jiù huì mào chū yí gè shēng yīn 。
sentences.english: Every so often while working, a voice rises in his head.

sentences.chinese: 这个能卖吗？
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge néng mài ma ？
sentences.english: Can this sell?

sentences.chinese: 这个值得吗？
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge zhí dé ma ？
sentences.english: Is this worth it?

sentences.chinese: 杂草每次听见这个声音，都把它压下去。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo měi cì tīng jiàn zhè ge shēng yīn ， dōu bǎ tā yā xià qù 。
sentences.english: Each time Weed hears that voice, he presses it down.

sentences.chinese: 然后继续做。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu jì xù zuò 。
sentences.english: Then he keeps working.

sentences.chinese: 慢慢地，他发现自己的手比平常更放松。
sentences.pinyin: màn màn dì ， tā fā xiàn zì jǐ de shǒu bǐ píng cháng gèng fàng sōng 。
sentences.english: Slowly, he notices that his hands are more relaxed than usual.

sentences.chinese: 眼睛也看得更细。
sentences.pinyin: yǎn jīng yě kàn dé gèng xì 。
sentences.english: His eyes also see more carefully.

sentences.chinese: 因为这一次，没有人站在他的心里催他快一点。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè yí cì ， méi yǒu rén zhàn zài tā de xīn lǐ cuī tā kuài yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: Because this time, no one is standing inside his heart urging him to go faster.

sentences.chinese: 做完以后，那件作品也许不是他最好的。
sentences.pinyin: zuò wán yǐ hòu ， nà jiàn zuò pǐn yě xǔ bú shì tā zuì hǎo de 。
sentences.english: When it is finished, that piece may not be his best.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草看着它，心里有一种很少见的平静。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo kàn zhe tā ， xīn lǐ yǒu yì zhǒng hěn shǎo jiàn de píng jìng 。
sentences.english: But as Weed looks at it, he feels a kind of peace he rarely experiences.

sentences.chinese: 他没有把它拿去市场。
sentences.pinyin: tā méi yǒu bǎ tā ná qù shì chǎng 。
sentences.english: He does not take it to the market.

sentences.chinese: 也没有急着找人看。
sentences.pinyin: yě méi yǒu jí zhe zhǎo rén kàn 。
sentences.english: Nor does he hurry to show it to anyone.

sentences.chinese: 他只是把它留着，放在自己看得见的地方。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì bǎ tā liú zhe ， fàng zài zì jǐ kàn dé jiàn de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: He simply keeps it and places it where he can see it.

sentences.chinese: 那一刻他终于明白，不是每一件作品都要先变成钱。
sentences.pinyin: nà yí kè tā zhōng yú míng bái ， bú shì měi yí jiàn zuò pǐn dōu yào xiān biàn chéng qián 。
sentences.english: At that moment he finally understands that not every piece must first turn into money.

sentences.chinese: 有的作品，是拿来卖的。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de zuò pǐn ， shì ná lái mài de 。
sentences.english: Some pieces are for selling.

sentences.chinese: 有的作品，是拿来让自己再往前走一点的。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de zuò pǐn ， shì ná lái ràng zì jǐ zài wǎng qián zǒu yì diǎn de 。
sentences.english: Some pieces are for helping himself move a little farther forward.
